QuestInfo.name: Lisa's Spring Flower Research 1
QuestInfo.0: Spring blooms in Maple World. You hear that #bLisa in Orbis#k is researching spring flowers but she needs your help. Let's go talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Let's help with the research to plant far more spring flowers!
QuestInfo.2: You successfully helped with the Spring Flower Research and finally, far more spring flowers bloom in Maple World.
QuestInfo.summary: Give 3 Azaleas to Lisa in Orbis.

0.0: Did you know that we are researching spring flowers for planting? We want far more of them in the Maple World! Your flowers will be a great help to our research.

yes.0: It will be a great help to the research on spring flowers in Maple World if you can deliver #b3 Azaleas#k to #bLisa in Orbis#k.  Hope you can do this now.

1.0: Spring flowers make me feel warm and fragrant. Do you have some Azaleas for me?

yes.0: Azaleas mean 'love'. I hope this pink azalea will spread love around Maple World! I will give you an #bAzalea Sticker#k to always keep a loving mind.\r\n

npc.0: Why didn't you go to Lisa quickly? You have to go to Orbis and give her #b3 Azaleas#k.

item.0: I need #b3 Azaleas#k. It seems you haven't collected them all yet. Please try hard.
